verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is API-first, so cards and cardholders can be created programmatically without a UI. An official Stripe CLI exists, and test simulation lets automated purchases run before going live, which together support headless automation. However, no evidence explicitly documents CI pipeline usage or non-interactive auth patterns, and the CLI is evidenced only by a probe. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless runbook documentation, non-interactive CLI/auth guidance for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
